entries.title: Psalms 105:1
segments: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.

entries.title: Psalms 105:2
segments: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him;  Talk ye of all his marvelous works.

entries.title: Psalms 105:3
segments: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 105:4
segments: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 105:5
segments: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

entries.title: Psalms 105:6
segments: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

entries.title: Psalms 105:7
segments: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 105:8
segments: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

entries.title: Psalms 105:9
segments: [The covenant] which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,

entries.title: Psalms 105:10
segments: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,

entries.title: Psalms 105:11
segments: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The  lot of your inheritance;

entries.title: Psalms 105:12
segments: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.

entries.title: Psalms 105:13
segments: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.

entries.title: Psalms 105:14
segments: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

entries.title: Psalms 105:15
segments: [Saying], Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.

entries.title: Psalms 105:16
segments: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.

entries.title: Psalms 105:17
segments: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:

entries.title: Psalms 105:18
segments: His feet they hurt with fetters:  He was laid in [chains of] iron,

entries.title: Psalms 105:19
segments: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.

entries.title: Psalms 105:20
segments: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

entries.title: Psalms 105:21
segments: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;

entries.title: Psalms 105:22
segments: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 105:23
segments: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:24
segments: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.

entries.title: Psalms 105:25
segments: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 105:26
segments: He sent Moses his servant, [And] Aaron whom he had chosen.

entries.title: Psalms 105:27
segments: They set among them  his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:28
segments: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.

entries.title: Psalms 105:29
segments: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.

entries.title: Psalms 105:30
segments: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.

entries.title: Psalms 105:31
segments: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.

entries.title: Psalms 105:32
segments: He gave them hail for rain, [And] flaming fire in their land.

entries.title: Psalms 105:33
segments: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.

entries.title: Psalms 105:34
segments: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,

entries.title: Psalms 105:35
segments: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.

entries.title: Psalms 105:36
segments: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The  chief of all their strength.

entries.title: Psalms 105:37
segments: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was  not one feeble person among his tribes.

entries.title: Psalms 105:38
segments: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:39
segments: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.

entries.title: Psalms 105:40
segments: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 105:41
segments: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places [like] a river.

entries.title: Psalms 105:42
segments: For he remembered his holy word, [And] Abraham his servant.

entries.title: Psalms 105:43
segments: And he brought forth his people with joy, [And] his chosen with singing.

entries.title: Psalms 105:44
segments: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:

entries.title: Psalms 105:45
segments: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws.  Praise ye Jehovah.
